phases.name: Phase 003 — Stripe Webhook Handling

requirements.content:
# Requirements: Stripe Webhook Handling

**Status:** APPROVED
**Profile:** api

## Core Requirements

### REQ-003.1 — Signature Verification
The webhook receiver must verify Stripe HMAC signatures using the configured webhook secret before parsing the payload body.

### REQ-003.2 — Idempotent Event Processing
The service must store incoming `event.id` values with a 24-hour TTL in cache to reject duplicate transmissions.

### REQ-003.3 — Asynchronous Queue Dispatch
Events must be enqueued into the background processing queue within 200ms of receipt, returning an HTTP 200 status immediately.

design.content:
# Design: Stripe Webhook Handling

**Status:** APPROVED

## Architecture Sequence

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  Stripe ->> Webhook Handler: POST /webhooks/stripe (Signed Event)
  Webhook Handler ->> Crypto Verifier: Validate Signature (HMAC SHA-256)
  Crypto Verifier -->> Webhook Handler: Valid Signature
  Webhook Handler ->> Cache: Check Event ID (Idempotency Key)
  Cache -->> Webhook Handler: Key not found (First seen)
  Webhook Handler ->> Event Queue: Enqueue 'invoice.payment_succeeded'
  Webhook Handler -->> Stripe: 200 OK (Event Acknowledged)
```

## Security Boundaries
- Never trust raw unverified JSON.
- Read raw request buffer before json parsing to calculate hash signature.

# Evidence: Webhook Idempotency Verification

**Result:** PASS  
**Assessed Tree / Revision:** 7b29e01  
**Environment:** Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, Node.js v22.13.0, Redis 7.2  
**Timestamp:** 2026-10-08T11:45:00Z  
**Limitations:** Tested using synthetic replay attacks and simulated network drops.  

## Procedure
1. Dispatched 50 duplicate webhook payloads with identical event ID `evt_test_12345`.
2. Confirmed that only the first request enqueued a processing job.
3. Confirmed subsequent 49 duplicate requests returned HTTP 200 without duplicate queue entries.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Reject any webhook request without valid HMAC-SHA256 signature header with HTTP 401.
Duplicate webhook deliveries within 24h return HTTP 200 without reprocessing.
Valid webhook payloads are published to Redis event queue within 50ms.

limitations.text: Tested using synthetic replay attacks and simulated network drops.

remediations.issue: Ensure redis cluster failover fallback lock when primary node restarts.

futureWork: No external third-party webhook sender credentials stored in plaintext.
Dead-letter queue consumer alerting threshold to be configured in phase 004.

rules.title: Rule: Before Starting Any Task
rules.enforcement: Enforced by Git pre-commit hooks & SDD Doctor
rules.content:
# Rule: Before Task

1. Confirm active phase status is APPROVED.
2. Ensure task ID exists in tasks.md.
3. Validate test runner environment.

rules.title: Rule: During Implementation
rules.enforcement: Enforced by Git pre-commit hooks & SDD Doctor
rules.content:
# Rule: During Task

1. Small focused commits referencing task and requirement IDs.
2. Do not mutate contracts or unrelated files.
3. Never disable pre-commit hooks.

rules.title: Rule: After Task Completion
rules.enforcement: Enforced by Git pre-commit hooks & SDD Doctor
rules.content:
# Rule: After Task

1. Run automated tests and capture evidence in `.sdd/evidence/`.
2. Mark task complete in `tasks.md`.
3. Synchronize `active-context.md`.
